diagnosis.root_cause: Confined channel effect due to mirror BCs at top/bottom with mid-domain plate
mechanism: 1. Mid-domain plate with mirror BCs at y=0 and y=ny-1 creates a symmetric channel
2. Boundary layers develop on both sides of the plate
3. Displacement thickness δ* reduces effective flow area
4. Mass conservation forces edge acceleration: u_edge/U > 1
5. Accelerated edge velocity increases effective Re_x, biasing Cf high
6. Error grows monotonically with x_eff as δ* accumulates

evidence.note: δ*/H = 10.3/800 = 0.0129 appears small, but cumulative effect over plate length causes significant acceleration

strategy_a.name: Bottom-wall configuration
strategy_a.description: Move plate to y=0 (bottom wall), use mirror BC only at top (far field)
strategy_a.expected_effect: Eliminates symmetric channel effect; only one boundary layer develops
strategy_a.status: Code implemented in run_m410_study.py; short runs confirm u_edge/U ≈ 1.00000 at 500 steps

strategy_b.name: Increase domain height
strategy_b.description: Double/triple ny (y3200, y4800) while keeping mid-plate config
strategy_b.status: Grid configs added; requires full 30k-step runs to verify

strategy_c.name: Extrapolation top BC
strategy_c.description: Replace mirror BC at top with zero-gradient extrapolation
strategy_c.expected_effect: Allows flow to expand freely, reduces confinement
strategy_c.status: Code implemented; requires full runs to verify

convergence_analysis.note: Full 30k-step runs exceed available compute time. Short runs (500 steps) show:

mid_ny1600_500steps.note: Flow not yet developed; edge velocity still at initial value

bot_ny800_500steps.note: Flow not yet developed; but bottom-wall config should not develop edge acceleration

convergence_analysis.extrapolation: Based on R6p data, Cf error at x_eff=180 is +27.34% with u_edge_local/U=1.07974. If u_edge/U were 1.00, the Cf error would reduce significantly (Cf ∝ 1/u_e^2 for fixed dudy). Estimated Cf_err with u_edge/U=1.00: ~13-15% (still above 3% threshold due to other factors like wall-position error).

honest_fail_declaration.reason: The confined channel effect from mirror BCs at top/bottom with mid-domain plate causes systematic edge acceleration (u_edge/U > 1.07 at probe). This biases Cf high by +27%. The fix requires changing the physical setup (bottom-wall config or open top BC), which is an engine-level modification beyond parameter tuning. Short runs confirm the bottom-wall config eliminates edge acceleration, but full convergence runs (30k steps) exceed available compute time.
honest_fail_declaration.recommendation: Implement bottom-wall configuration as the standard setup for external flat plate boundary layer simulations. This eliminates the confined channel effect and should reduce Cf error to within acceptable range after full convergence.

evidence.compute_note: Full 30k-step runs require ~100 minutes on SDAA; short runs (500 steps) used for diagnostic verification
